flags.message: gemini-baseline describes 2021–2025 as its prior-Term baseline, but its frozen context.term is 2025. The stated anchor includes its own Term and omits displayed eligible earlier Terms. Evaluation uses the matching sal-v4 baseline risk set over 2017–2024 (rendered weighted rate 0.05120250431778929). This lowers confidence in the rationale, not the mechanical outcome score; no own-case outcome retrieval is evidenced in this forward cell. See gemini-baseline evaluation.md.
